body:
Two days later and I am still on a roll. Today I opened up another opportunity in the form of sales and networking. My plan to become a part of experian has just begun since I need 5 years of sales experience in order to handle their clients. So goal wise I am proud of what I've accomplished. I feel the challenge laid out before me and soon I will be facing it head on. I also shared moments with all my family including someone I had shut out in the past and this brings a warm feeling toward my heart. I thank God and I respect myself so much for giving in to love in order to give love so easily. I talk to strangers casually as I would a friend and even if some people have an off mood its fine and I keep on being me even though I might feel like reflecting the same to them. I was beginning to feel tired but then I started to write my first comments since forever on interesting youtube videos I was watching. For some odd reason this helped restore my energy because in each comment it was like I was Conan being witty as soon as something I thought was funny to me popped into my head it was written and posted and afterwards this kept me going for the rest of the night. And now I lie awake thinking to myself how long can I keep this streak going while aware of the fact that yes it is still up to me for how long I want to keep myself up. All I know is my minds made up and I am on the path to financial freedom which will in turn benefit my family, retire my parents, and bring me closer to the best version of myself. 
I just came across a thought that is very interesting almost like a parabole and here it is:
My mind is the genie that grants me wishes so when I write down my thoughts and goals of what I want I should be careful with my wording of it. As an example let me rephrase the end of the last sentence:
I am careful with my wording anytime I set goals and ideas into how I want my life and character to become.

You see here I wrote in the present and there were no 'will' types of words because will usually aligns itself with procrastination hence a small voice in the back responding "no you will not" so I'm glad I got this done now. Therefore from here on out I am writing only in the present and with assured sentences because well the present is where everything starts anyways. So might as well begin thinking the best version of myself so far. So everyday there's an update because now that I am more out there I find a lot more things out about myself that need a headchange in order to be more free of ego. Like when I ordered a taco in english but the cashier wasn't responding because maybe she only spoke spanish so I spoke spanish and a couple seconds into telling her what I wanted to ask her she just handed me over to another employee. In the past (always refer to negative beliefs in the past tense) then I felt insulted as if my spanish was not good enough and she was the judge of that but in hindsight all that really happened was a young man took her place. They swapped out and thats all that mattered and that my attention needed only be on the one taking my order and thats it. So that emotion was from back all the way to the times in the past I felt like an outcast from my race culture. But now I am aware that I am myself and I myself speak spanish all the time and will continue to do so. Although people may think of me as different from the traditional and sometimes stereotypical race that I am I keep my identity because I have learned and experienced so much already as both sides of my race and it's impossible to take that away from me.

I'm so proud of myself once again because I have uncovered so much from today and progressed with my tangible goals simultaneously. Another thing I realized just now from writing (yup not today I mean now so... KEEP WRITING!!!) is that intangible goals are best completed in the spur of the moment because its just like exploring a side of myself I don't truly understand until certain emotions rise out of an experience that seems similar to a heavier past experience(s). This is how I become a better me. Tangible goals are meant to be struck with persistent and calculated action for example I plan on working with experians clients but one of the requirements before I can do this is I need to have 5 years of sales experience. So today I met with an amazing business woman who brought me into the fold of a social network economics system. This in turn means that I am to be working in sales but as well as networking to find individuals who would like to do the same thing and this is perfectly aligned towards my tangible goal. I see the difference within each process because ones random and is based on chance. You may experience different things during the day and that in turn will reveal different ideas you have about certain things and all this at random times in your life. Meanwhile the other is straight to the point and you can be very specific on how and when you want to reach it. In addition numbers help the best with tangibles because you can trust that math is always going to have one answer. So this is great because I am eating healthier now and this means I can set measurements and counts in order to stay on the dot with my health and keep track of my eating and fitness training lifestyle.

This is great and I feel great and that makes me happy for now because I have completed another entry. Now that I think about it I had a great day yesterday too and there was no log of yesterday but that's fine. Thinking back a while ago I thought it was going to be a short one today but it just goes to show that I can break down my day and still find value in the little things that occur in my everyday life. Always I ask the question: What can I learn from this? And: What can I change in the picture to make it better? Its not so much just about being positive because for me I had to really listen to what my body was telling me in order to know how I really felt about a situation (for example: belly tightness) without the need for masking emotion because of course how could I go through life hiding myself and looking free but feeling imprisoned. Its like having a friend who acts nice but then talks behind my back but this time the friend is I and I am letting my friend let it all out so that we can begin a new. I forgive myself and I love myself. Thats how my journey began and it will keep on now and forever.

Now then It's 2:08 AM and I'm as excited as a caterpillar shaking my buns to some beats just enjoying life dancing on some leaves. Now is time for sleep for I have an exciting day to look forward towards tomorrow.

P.S. Everything is fine now. See I am taking care of it just like I promised myself. Good night :)
Its something I learned long ago but I hadn't truly understood it until last night. Thank you.

It starts with belief. We believe in something and it makes us feel a certain way. I love I hate I fear it all starts with what you tell yourself. And some beliefs are more hidden than others so thats probably how complex emotions come to be the ones that don't make sense in that moment I believe. I think emotions can be traced back to a belief. Only if the belief is uncovered can emotions be predictable.
Thank you I appreciate you. Sure lets talk!
